content: वसनम् [वस्-आधारे ल्युट्] .²1 Dwelling, residing, staying. .²2 A house, residence. .²3 Dressing, clothing, covering. .²4 A garment, cloth, dress, clothes; वसने परिधूसरे वसाना <ls>Ś. 7. 21</ls>; उत्सङ्गे वा मलिनवसने सौम्य निक्षिप्य वीणाम् <ls>Me. 88</ls>, <ls n="Me.">43</ls>. .²5 An ornament worn (by women) round the loins, (probably for रसना). .²6 Siege. .²7 A leaf of the cinnamon tree. .{@-ना@} (in <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Clothed in. .²2 Surrounded by; समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले. .²3 Engrossed by.
